unit: words of the whole file, as `LC_ALL=C wc -w` counts them: a SKILL.md keyed by its skill's directory, frontmatter included, and a role file beside it keyed `<skill>/<file>`
raise: only in the commit that needs it, recorded in `raises` as {"from": <old>, "to": <new>, "why": "<the sentence skill-retro Step 4 asks for>"}; `skill-lint.py --against <ref>` fails a rise without one

skill-retro.why: Steps 2, 4 and 6 now name the `raises` entry, the `--against` run that holds it, and that a new file's budget rises from 0, which the linter and pool-run both check

pr-harden.why: State's sentence on the EnterWorktree isolation guard said it refuses a compound command that runs git, which four transcripts measured wrong both ways; it now says the guard refuses what it cannot verify, git or not, that a script run by absolute path passes, and that $PPID is refused even unchained (+23, records #562 and #564). Section 6's 'Neither is ever recorded as a blocking finding' is scoped to inside a round so it stops contradicting FINISH (+2), and the owner paragraph names each gate's own entry (+4), which makes the --owner $PPID sentence after the pr-set example a restatement, pruned (-26)

pr-harden/fixer.md.why: the fixer is told to read fixer.md before it does anything else, as the verifier already was, so a compliant read is one role-file-check decides mechanically (owner's decision, 2026-09-27)

pr-harden/reviewer.md.why: the reviewer's two standing rules, the JSON it returns and what makes a finding blocking move here from SKILL.md byte for byte, beneath a new header that tells it to read the file first and what its brief carries, as pr-harden 0.36.0 moved the fixer's and the verifier's, once role-file-check's wave 1 passed (2026-09-28). The header and SKILL.md's pointer are new text, so pr-harden grows by both, for a reviewer that reads these rules as written instead of the orchestrator's paraphrase of them, which is what wave 1's briefs carried

resolve-ticket/refuter.md.why: the plan refuter's seven questions, the JSON it returns and the rule every objection must meet move here from SKILL.md byte for byte, beneath a new header that tells it to read the file first and what its brief carries, the shape pr-harden 0.36.0 gave the fixer and the verifier, once role-file-check's wave 1 passed (2026-09-28). The header and SKILL.md's pointer are new text, so resolve-ticket grows by both, for a refuter that reads its questions as written
